title: I Know Why the Caged Bird Sings
author: Maya Angelou
current_text: In 1983, four members of the Alabama State Textbook Committee called for the rejection of I Know Why the Caged Bird Sings, claiming it preached “bitterness and hatred toward white people” and encouraged “deviant behavior” through references to lesbianism, premarital sex and profanity.

sources.quote: In 1983, four members of the Alabama State Textbook Committee called for the rejection of “I Know Why the Caged Bird Sings,” claiming the work preaches “bitterness and hatred toward white people and encourages deviant behavior because of references to lesbianism, premarital sex and profanity.”
